result.title: Bi-Refine: Semantic Verification-Guided Progressive Refinement for Moment Retrieval
result.summary: Moment Retrieval (MR) aims to identify the temporal segment in an untrimmed video that corresponds to a natural language query. Existing approaches commonly refine temporal predictions within the localization pathway, without explicitly verifying candidate-level semantic consistency. Moreover, directly reusing semantic scores as feedback can cause over-correction when the verification signal is unreliable. To address these issues, we propose Bi-Refine, a semantic verification-guided progressive refinement framework that formulates MR as a closed-loop verification-and-refinement process. A Heuristic Localization Branch first generates candidate moments, while a Semantic Verification Branch evaluates their query consistency in a semantically enriched latent space. Query supervision further trains the verifier with the same candidate moment but different queries, encouraging it to distinguish the matched query from semantically similar mismatched queries. The resulting verification features are incorporated into a Progressive Refinement Loop that updates both query representations and multimodal features. To suppress potentially harmful updates, a lightweight reliability estimator gates query updates and reweights candidate contributions in feature feedback. A convergence-based adaptive stopping strategy additionally terminates unnecessary refinement during inference. Experiments on three standard MR benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and state-of-the-art performance of our method.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Bi-Refine，把视频时刻检索建模为「定位—语义验证」闭环：定位分支产生候选片段，验证分支在语义增强的隐空间中评估候选与查询的一致性，并用可靠性估计门控查询更新与特征反馈，最后以收敛式自适应策略终止迭代。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「隐空间候选-查询验证 + 门控式状态更新 + 自适应停止」与 LVR 中视觉证据筛选及 STOP 的收益/成本判断有可核查的方法线索，但任务属视频时刻检索，迁移性需读原文确认。
